name: pumperly-mcp
description: Queries fuel prices, finds nearby stations, plans routes and geocodes places through a Pumperly instance (the public pumperly.com or your own), read-only and with no API key. Install: `npx -y pumperly-mcp` (set `PUMPERLY_URL`) · [Docs](https://github.com/GeiserX/pumperly-mcp/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md)
